author: TeIq
content: Approach: Per architect's pre-flight, implementing minimum scaffold: DbConfig, PgPool constructor with sqlx::migrate runner, /healthz that pool.acquire().await's without SQL. NO sqlx::query! macros this issue (zero queries — that's #13). Storing PgPool directly in Db struct (PgPool is internally Arc'd; no extra wrapping). DbError via thiserror; AppConfig as central config; testcontainers integration smoke test that skips gracefully when docker absent.
